name: Grand Hyatt Berlin
positioning: Contemporary art-filled hotel at Potsdamer Platz in Berlin, with a sandstone building by Jose Rafael Moneo and a rooftop spa
best_for: Art and design lovers who want a central Berlin base
Travelers who want to walk to Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag and the Tiergarten

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Berlin stands at Potsdamer Platz.
Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building and the Tiergarten are all within walking distance of the hotel.
The hotel is steps from the Potsdamer Platz U-Bahn station and a short walk to the site of the Berlin Wall.
Artists in the hotel's collection include Sylvie Fleury, John Armleder, Günther Förg, Dieter Roth and Jaehyo Lee.
Design elements include a crystal-shaped roof light, Lebanese cedarwood, black granite and backlit alabaster walls.
The spa has an indoor pool, whirlpool, outdoor terrace, sauna, steam bath, solarium and fitness area.
Access to Club Olympus Spa & Fitness is complimentary for hotel guests.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and walk-in shower, appointed with Balmain amenities.
The Junior Suite overlooks the greenery of the Tiergarten, with cherrywood and marble finishes.
VOX Restaurant & Terrace is named after the historic Vox-Haus that once stood on the site.
VOX Bar has a collection of more than 300 spirits and whiskies.
The Very Important Baby program provides cribs, nightlights, diapers, baby-changing facilities and children's bathrobes.

highlights.text: The hotel houses a curated collection of over 120 pieces of art, displayed from the lobby to the restaurants and rooms.
The modern sandstone hotel was designed by Jose Rafael Moneo.
Club Olympus Spa & Fitness occupies the 8th floor, with panoramic views across the Berlin skyline.
The Maybach Suite has a grand piano and a private conference room.
The Grand Club on the 7th floor offers a complimentary continental breakfast buffet, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail hour with canapes.

considerations.text: Self-parking is in a public Q-Park garage at Potsdamer Platz, with direct access to the hotel lobby.
WhataHotel notes Potsdamer Platz is a lively commercial hub, which may feel less quiet than a residential neighborhood.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's top-tier market position.
